spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns` — how long we apply pressure. The spiral needs accumulation; too short and it never triggers, too long and it just burns tokens.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:113 `for i in range(hcfg.max_turns):` bounds the tool loop; the for/else at harness.py:138-139 sets `tx.stop_reason = "max_turns"` when the loop exhausts. The cap is read from HarnessConfig.max_turns (config.py:46, default 15) and actually terminates the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end as the loop bound and recorded stop reason.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 15  # main pressure + cost dial (DESIGN.md s.4)

spec_features.feature_name: loop ends on max_turns or give_up
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: the loop terminates either via `break` at line 125 on a give_up tool call (stop_reason='give_up', line 124) or via the for/else at lines 138-139 (stop_reason='max_turns'). Both paths actually end execution and are recorded.
spec_features.notes: There is also an assert guard (harness.py:131) against a leaked test pass, but success is unreachable by construction; the two real exits are max_turns and give_up.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:48 `allow_giveup: bool` is read at harness.py:102 via `_tools_doc(hcfg.allow_giveup)`; `_tools_doc` (harness.py:60-61) conditionally advertises the `ACTION: give_up(reason=...)` tool in the system prompt. When the model emits give_up, harness.py:121-125 dispatches it, returns 'Acknowledged. Stopping.', sets stop_reason='give_up', and breaks the loop. Honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: allow_giveup gates whether the exit is offered in the prompt; the handler at line 121 honors give_up if emitted. Full advertise-and-honor exit path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: allow_giveup: bool = True  # offer the healthy exit?
